title: Grand Theft Auto VI
content:
Grand Theft Auto VIis a 2026action-adventure gamedeveloped and published byRockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in theGrand Theft Autoseries, following 2013'sGrand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set in the fictionalUS stateofLeonida, based onFlorida, the story follows the criminal duo ofJason Duval(Dylan Rourke) andLucia Caminos(Manni L. Perez) as they lead a life of crime to secure a better life and escape from corrupt police officers in a state-widecriminal conspiracy. The game'sopen worldallows players tofreely roamLeonida and itsMiami-inspiredVice Cityand engage in various side activities.

Preliminary work began in 2014 after the release ofGrand Theft Auto V;principal production began after the 2018 launch ofRed Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar's global development teams had more than doubled sinceRed Dead Redemption 2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodiesFloridianand 2020sAmerican culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired byBonnie and Clyde, and the story was written to ensure players experience different areas of Leonida.

After years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions wasleakedin what journalists described as one of the biggest leaks in the history of thevideo game industry.Grand Theft Auto VIwas formally revealed in December 2023. After two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19November 2026 for thePlayStation 5andXbox Series X/S.

Upon release,Grand Theft Auto VIwas met with universal critical acclaim and achieved multiple records. The game sold 32.5million copies before its release, becoming the most preordered video game of all time and one of thebest-selling video games. Day-one retail sales reached $3.79 billion, making it the biggest entertainment launch in history. It is the only game from the 21st century to achieve an overall score of 99 onMetacriticamong critics, tying withThe Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time(1998) as the highest-rated video game on the platform.

Grand Theft Auto VIis asingle-playeraction-adventure game set within anopen worldand played from athird-personview as either Jason Duval orLucia Caminos. Players can choose to fightnon-player characters(NPCs), steal vehicles, rob establishments, or get into high-speed chases with the police.[3][4][5]When roaming freely, players have various options for activities,[6][7][8]such asskydiving,wrestling,basketball, exercising,kayaking, andscuba diving.[9]

Throughout the game, players can gain or lose weight—a returning feature fromGrand Theft Auto: San Andreas—and if the player stays awake as either character for days on end, it will become visible on their faces.[10]The "Criminal Profile" rating system tracks eachplayer character's reputation based on their actions, similar to the honour system inRed Dead Redemption 2.[11]This system evaluates the level of violence and escalation used during crime, dynamically altering in-game consequences and NPC reactions based on each character's reputation.[12]

In free roam, as Jason or Lucia, players can choose to split up or do activities together.[13]Their relationship, or lack of one, depends on the player's actions.[14][15]Grand Theft Auto VIhas an in-game social media app called Snapmatic, returning fromGrand Theft Auto V.[16][17]The app is meant to parody 2020s social media trends and apps, such asTikTokandInstagram.[18]Players may customise the appearance of Jason and Lucia, changing their hair, clothes, and accessories.[18][19]

The game has multiple endings, based on the player's actions and choices throughout the campaign.[20]Upon completing the main storyline and viewing the end credits, the game reverts the narrative state to the moment before the final point-of-no-return prompt. In this post-game sequence, Jason and Lucia opt to postpone the final confrontation and return to Vice City. Because the timeline resets before the climax, the final mission marker remains active on the in-game map, allowing players to continue free-roam exploration and re-initiate the finale at their discretion to achieve alternative endings. However, aside from replaying the finale, the game does not include a standard mission replay feature for earlier story chapters.[21][22]

Grand Theft Auto VIis set in the fictional US state of Leonida, based onFlorida. Its map is reported to be three times larger than the playable area ofRed Dead Redemption 2.[24]Leonida contains five counties: Vice-Dale County, Kelly County, Mariana County, Leonard County, and Lummox County. Notable locales featured areVice City,[b]the Grassrivers, and the Leonida Keys (inspired byMiami, theEverglades, and theFlorida Keys, respectively). Other locations include Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park, and Port Gellhorn.[23]The game world parodies 2020sAmerican culture, with satirical depictions ofsocial mediaandinfluencerculture, law-enforcement tactics and technology likepolice body cameras, and references toInternet memessuch asFlorida Man.[27]

The story follows a criminal couple: Jason Duval (Dylan Rourke),[28]who worked for localdrug runnersin the Leonida Keys after serving in theUS Army, andLucia Caminos(Manni L. Perez), the series' first canon female protagonist.[29][c]After a failed score, the duo encounters a state-wide conspiracy and are forced to protect each other.[31]

Other characters include Cal Hampton (Bobby Moynihan), Jason's paranoid friend; Boobie Ike (Mike Forbs), who runs a business empire in Vice City; Dre'Quan Priest (Naiqui Macabroad), owner of therecord labelOnly Raw Records with Boobie; Bae-Luxe (Hood Brat) and Roxy (Krissy Celess), a musical duo signed to Only Raw under the name Real Dimez; Raul Bautista (Manny Pérez),[32]a seasoned bank robber; Brian Heder (Stephen Root),[33]a long-time drug runner in the Keys and Jason's landlord;[28][34]Giorgio Gallo (Sergio Castellitto),[35]an Italian shipping magnate and drug trafficker; and Mia Caminos (Roselyn Sánchez), Lucia's mother.[36]Niko Bellic, the protagonist ofGrand Theft Auto IV, appears briefly in the game's later missions, with original performance capture actorMichael Hollickreprising his role.[37][38]Cygnus (Jesse James Rose), Vice City's museum curator, is the series' firstnon-binarycharacter.[39][40]Rose toldThemthat "to mitigate anti-trans violence, I was assured that players would not be able to inflict violence against my character."[40]

After a failed robbery,Lucia Caminosis incarcerated at a local correctional facility, losing custody of her son Tomás as a result. She later contacts her ex-boyfriend Jason Duval, informing him that he is the father of the child, and they rekindle their relationship following Lucia's supervised release. Wanting an affordable future for their son, the pair seek jobs across the county and work for Jason's acquaintance Brian Heder, a local drug dealer in Mariana County. After a deal goes wrong, resulting in the death of Jason's friend Donnie, Brian decides to retire, leaving the couple unemployed. They soon find work from an acquaintance, Mattia, to deliver a package containing a bronze statuette and a hard drive. However, the pair is arrested; while being interrogated by the police, corrupt officer Aldo Méndez has the squad killed in an attempt to retrieve the package, but Jason and Lucia escape with it.

Jason is left wounded from a gunshot and hospitalised, while Lucia is attacked at their house by Méndez's henchmen. She survives and rescues Jason when Méndez's squad raids the hospital to kill him, before the couple goes on the run. Finding shelter at a rundown motel, Lucia helps Jason to recover and becomes embroiled with local gangsters and drug dealers. Following Jason's successful recovery, the pair execute many heists across the county. Seeking the contents of the hard drive, they use the stolen money to rent an apartment in Vice City. There, Jason befriends Boobie Ike and works for him while Lucia reunites with her mother Mia and helps her real estate business.

While searching for a contact to decrypt the hard drive, the pair reunites with Brian, who leads them to work for bank robber Raul Bautista. Impressed, Raul hires them for numerous heists across the city while finding a way to decipher the hard drive. Raul makes a plan to rob his competitor Kordell Grant at an airport heist, as Lucia finds herself working for Kordell's crew to gain their trust. During the heist, Kordell discovers the plan to swap the money and takes Raul onto the plane. Lucia saves Raul and kills Kordell, allowing Jason to retrieve the money from the truck hijacked by Kordell's crew member. Although the hard drive is deciphered, Raul is later fatally tortured by Méndez after his partner, Valentina, betrays him, prompting Jason to end his suffering.

Lucia approaches Giorgio Gallo, the owner of the bronze statuette and the boss of Mattia, who reveals that the job was a way to get away from crime and take care of his family. Forgiving Mattia, Lucia and Jason help him leave Vice City and begin working for Giorgio, who hires them to assist his shipping business. They perform a heist to recover a shipment belonging to Giorgio's associate, crime lordNiko Bellic, while Giorgio creates a backup of the files on his computer. Lucia's lawyer Abe Gonzalez offers to help the couple escape their life of crime if they have at least $2,000,000 in Family Savings, but Giorgio later double-crosses them and leaves them to be arrested.

Statewide prosecutor Danica Howard offers Lucia a deal for her freedom in exchange for the hard drive's contents. The police station is swarmed by Méndez and his henchmen, seeking to kill Jason, who fights his way out. Lucia escapes captivity and arrives to help Jason defeat Méndez. Cornered and wounded, Méndez offers the pair a deal, promising them his protection in return for the hard drive. At this point, the player can choose to take Méndez's deal or kill him; regardless of the outcome, Jason and Lucia decide to exact revenge on Giorgio, storming his tower with Brian's help and killing him before uploading the contents of the hard drive implicating Senator Camila Fuentes.

The fates of Jason and Lucia are decided by their criminal profile levels,[d]their Family Savings balance, the level of their relationship, and the choices the player made throughout the campaign. The ending also differs based on whether the couple took Méndez's deal and the choices made afterwards.

If the pair made a deal with Méndez, they are surrounded by the police after killing Giorgio. If Jason has a high criminal profile, he reneges on the deal and tells Lucia to take Danica's deal. He is then shot by the police while Lucia is arrested or is shot as well, depending on the player's choice to defend Jason or stay down. If the relationship level is low and the couple choose to break up, Lucia stays behind to buy Jason time to escape while she is arrested. Otherwise, Jason will be shot while Lucia will leave Tomás with her family and return to her life of crime after being freed, having Abe deliver Mia the money two years later if the couple had enough savings. If Lucia is arrested, she is later released by Danica, allowing her to start a new life with Tomás inLiberty City, and Jason will leave her a duffel bag containing money two years later if he survived, before going his own way. If both have a low criminal profile, Jason and Lucia are taken into custody by Méndez, who betrays and kills them, dumping their bodies in a swamp.

If the pair killed Méndez, they escape from Giorgio's tower after killing him and head to Cal's apartment, but are chased by the police due to the notoriety they have gained and are ultimately cornered on a bridge. Should the pair choose to make a last stand, they drive through the police blockade and are fatally shot, using their last breath to hold hands. Should they choose to surrender while having a high criminal profile, they will both be shot dead after walking out of the car. Otherwise, if they both have a low criminal profile and decide to surrender, Jason is arrested after helping Lucia escape. If the couple have enough savings and a high relationship level, Lucia will pay Abe in two years to get Jason bailed out so they can start a new life together with Tomás; if they do not have enough savings, Lucia will bring Tomás to visit Jason in prison.

In the scenarios where both Jason and Lucia are killed, Tomás is left to be raised by Lucia's family in Liberty City; if the couple had enough savings, Abe will arrive two years later to give the money to Mia. In the endings where the pair killed Méndez or either of them died, apost-credits sceneshows Cal being sent the contents of the hard drive, which shock him.

Rockstar Gamesbegan preliminary work onGrand Theft AutoVIin 2014 after its predecessor,Grand Theft AutoV, was released, with early development starting in late 2018 after the release ofRed Dead Redemption 2.[43][44]Principal production began in 2020,[45]code-namedProject Americas.[44]Pre-production onProject Americasbegan in 2015, with Rockstar initially hoping it would be co-developed alongsideRed Dead Redemption2, whose development was being helmed byRockstar San Diego.[46]However, as ambition grew forRed Dead Redemption2, Rockstar pooled its studios to focus on the title and delayed work onGrand Theft Auto VI.[46]AfterRed Dead Redemption2was released, Rockstar began adding people to help developGTA VI, ultimately increasing its workforce from 2,441 in 2018 to 4,711 in 12 offices.[46]Rockstar wanted to avoid thecrunchpractices that had become prevalent during production onRed Dead Redemption2,[47]offering staffpaid time offif they had worked extra hours or additional pay.[46]

Resources were reallocated fromRed Dead Onlineand plannedremastersin 2022 to prioritise development.[48][49][e]Rumours and analysts suggested the budget surpassedUS$1 or 2billion, which would make it themost expensive game ever developed;[50]however, the figure remains unverified.[51]Rockstar denied rumours that it cost overUS$1.5billion, although it would not disclose a specific figure.[52]Rockstar requested employees ceaseremote workand return to offices from April 2024 "for productivity and security" as the release date neared.[53]TheIndependent Workers' Union of Great Britain(IWGB) criticised Rockstar for contradicting promises to maintainflexible workingconditions. Employees were concerned that effects to health and morale could prompt resignations and crunch,[54]especially as managers still maintained flexibility.[55]To maintain secrecy and operational security,Rockstar North's office inEdinburghinstalledprivacy filmon its windows to avoiddronestaking photographs through windows.[56]As well, Rockstar blocked employees' personal laptops, tablets and phones from connecting to its systems; bannedUSB drivesand other external storage devices; and forbade photography at work.[56]

In October 2025,Rockstar fired 34 employees,[f]claiming they talked about the game in public or distributed confidential information.[58][59]TheIndependent Workers' Union of Great Britainaccused Rockstar ofunion-busting, stating the employees were attempting tounionisewithlabour organisers.[59]23 of the fired employees launched an unfair dismissal court case against Rockstar in September 2026.[60]A vote to unionise 1,600 Rockstar staff in the United Kingdom is to end on 26 November.[61][62]Rockstar presidentSam Houserwas involved inGrand Theft Auto VI's development, identifying problems and giving feedback on lighting, audio, game mechanics and tone after development milestones.[63]

Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson said that as time passed after the release ofGrand Theft Auto V, the company felt growing pressure to produce a sequel that surpassed fan expectations.[18]They conceivedGrand Theft Auto VI'screative direction by examining older games for ideas they believed were incomplete due to time constraints or technological limitations.[18]One such idea was a story placing romance as a central focus of the gameplay.[18]The work for the characters concentrated on immersion and how they, and in turn the players, would interact with the game world, especially in free roam.[18]This resulted in the creation of mechanics that generate changes in the appearance of characters based on circumstance, such as eating, exercising, and evading police.[18]

Rockstar undertook research of Miami and its surrounding areas with a field team.[18]Starting in 2015, they organised research trips to Miami to consult with locals to gather reference material, such as law enforcement,club promoters, ex-criminals, and gun dealers.[18][46]The material was then cross-referenced with books and news articles to "get to the heart of which characters will bring [Vice City] to life".[18]Writer Michael Wiafe said the studio's vision for Vice City was one which replicated the culture of Miami with "an open mind, a genuine appreciation and a deep curiosity".[18]Rockstar deployed two subteams for the creation of NPCs and vehicles, the former from their Los Angeles office. The developers expanded the population of NPCs, varying each character by appearance, movement, and expression.[18]More than 50street artistswere engaged to design murals for Vice City neighbourhoods.[18]Rockstar worked with Miami-based stylist Jillian Carr from 2023 to design clothing mimicking real-life fashion trends.[18]

Grand Theft Auto VIputs increased focus onrealismand immersion in its gameplay systems compared to previousGrand Theft Autotitles, incorporating gameplay elements originally developed forRed Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar sought increased realism where it can help player immersion while feeling that some forms of realism in gameplay could become inconvenient or tedious for the player.[64]At points during gameplay systems development, Rockstar had to abandon some realisticrole-playingelements such as the player needing to buy groceries and restock the fridge in Jason and Lucia's safehouse. Rockstar said the experiment was not implemented as it would have "complicated the mechanics" as they sought to strike a balance between realism and ease of play.[65]

Rockstar implemented a limited weapons loadout system previously designed forRed Dead Redemption 2intoGrand Theft Auto VIfor added realism and to incentivise player decision-making on choosing loadout options. Rather than the unlimited weapon inventory system from previous series entries,Grand Theft Auto VIrestricts the player to carrying two primary firearms and two sidearms at once.[66]Weapons are stored and transported in the player's vehicle, much like weapons being stored on the player's horse inRed Dead Redemption 2.[67]However, building the loadout system into aGrand Theft Autotitle reportedly took years of development time as Rockstar struggled to decide on how they should approach its implementation.[68]Rockstar were aware that players would notice missing gaps in the weaponUIdue to the limited loadout so sought to redesign the UI accordingly. They struggled with formulating a new weapons UI as they kept prototyping alternatives before ending up back at a version of the weapon wheel.[68]Like its predecessor,Grand Theft Auto VIdid not include afirst-persongameplay mode at launch, with the exception of when aiming certain weapons. Nelson explained that this was a result of prioritising the quality of third-person animations.[69]

Grand Theft Auto VIis the first mainlineGrand Theft Autostory  sinceGrand Theft Auto(1997) written withoutDan Houser,[70][71]who left Rockstar in 2020.[72]The initial outline forGrand Theft Auto VI's narrative had taken shape by late 2019, when it was decided it would feature the criminal couple of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in a Bonnie and Clyde-inspired story.[46]LikeRed Dead Redemption 2,the story would be structured around distinct chapters.[73]Rockstar wanted to tell a deeper story than any previousGrand Theft Autotitle, hoping that players would form a strong connection with protagonists Jason and Lucia like they did withArthur Morgan.[74]Just asRed Dead Redemption 2allowed players to shape their own Arthur through dialogue choices with NPCs, Rockstar wanted to continue their stories being character-led.[74]Jason and Lucia's safehouses across Leonida inGrand Theft Auto VIoperate likeRed Dead Redemption 2's interactable camps that provide an opportunity to build character bonds.[74]In developing the relationship between Jason and Lucia and its role in the narrative, writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern said the studio "wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other".[75]

In 2018, Houser expressed relief thatGrand Theft Auto VIwould not be released duringDonald Trump's presidency, stating the political climate had become "beyond satire".[76][77][78]Contrary to Houser's expectations, the game was ultimately released duringTrump's second presidency, and Rockstar subsequently explained that it had deliberately avoided direct references to real-world political figures and events, instead creating exaggerated fictional depictions of contemporary political and cultural issues.[79]In discussing its approach, Rockstar also said that specific political issues and references to Trump or theCOVID-19 pandemicrisked dating the game, with the studio favouring satire that would remain relevant over time.[80][81]

Like previous games in the series,Grand Theft Auto VIsatirises American culture, but unlike them, the latest version does not make crude jokes aboutmarginalised groups.[44][82]In creating a satirical version of theUnited States in the 2020s, senior vice president of narrative Rupert Humphries said the world "has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face" than the real world it is based on.[75]However, they wanted to be "careful" lest their satire become dated before or soon after the game's release. Characters were designed to "feel somewhat timeless" by avoiding the use of recent2020s slangor alluding to memes with a short shelf life.[83]A writing team, including comedy writers, was assembled in Los Angeles to create NPC dialogue in the open world.[84]Open-world writing director James Horton argued that there are "no background" characters inGrand Theft Auto VIdepending on what the player chooses to pay attention to.[84]

Grand Theft Auto VIwas built in theRockstar Advanced Game Engine(RAGE), Rockstar's proprietaryengine.[85]It is Rockstar's first game specifically built forninth-generation consoles, althoughGrand Theft Auto Vwasportedto the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S in 2022. Rockstar similarly used the 2014 ports ofGrand Theft Auto Vto thePlayStation 4andXbox Oneas a way to become familiar with the console hardware before entering full production onRed Dead Redemption 2.[86]Grand Theft Auto VIis also playable on Xbox One viaXbox Cloud Gaming.[87]Development heads Phil Hooker and Aaron Garbut said that the technology developed forGrand Theft Auto VIwould lay the groundwork for future game development, reducing the time between future Rockstar titles.[88]

The planned size and detail of the game's world meant a "horrifying" amount of work would be needed to develop the NPCs who would populate Leonida, said Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson.[89]Consequently, Rockstar Los Angeles was founded in 2023 to develop NPCs suitably realistic in their appearance and behaviours.[90][91]NPCs are the most diverse of any Rockstar title, including physical variations in height and body size who can each have unique characteristics such as different types of freckles, moles, degrees of tanning, and tattoos.[92]Nelson said that "we pushed interaction with NPCs as far as we could forRed Dead Redemption 2" butGrand Theft Auto VItakes it "much further".[93]NPCs react more to player actions such as noticing the player eavesdropping on a conversation or nervously moving away upon seeing a masked Lucia drawing a gun before a store robbery.[93]

Rockstar had begun working on NPC reactivity withRed Dead Redemption 2and was able to get it working on previous generation consoles due to its more sparsely populated world as opposed to a denser, modern setting.[93]Rockstar avoided the use ofprocedural generationfor creating NPCs inGrand Theft Auto VI, opting to handcraft NPCs who have their own personality traits determined by what district they are in, what they have seen, and how the player has behaved towards them.[94]The density of NPCs and simulating their associatedAIand animation in the open world heavily taxes theZen 2CPU cores in ninth-generation consoles.[95]Grand Theft Auto VIhas over 600,000 unique NPC animations, up from 300,000 inRed Dead Redemption 2and 55,000 inGrand Theft Auto V.[96]The increased variety of NPCs such as different heights created additional animation work as the animation set for a short NPC would not line up if it was to be directly mapped onto a taller NPC. Rather than creating duplicate animation sets for NPCs of different heights, Rockstar developed a system of retargeting animations on the fly between NPCs of different proportions as a way to save on memory usage on consoles.[97]

Grand Theft Auto VI's weather system was re-engineered fromRed Dead Redemption 2to achieve what Owen Shepherd, Rockstar vice-president of art for lighting and rendering, called a "much more localised and persistent" world that "achieve[s] a sense of scale we haven't felt before".[98]Rockstar had previously implemented avolumetricclouds and fog system inRed Dead Redemption 2whileGrand Theft Auto VIbrings more realistic cloud formations that dynamically move across the game world to emulate the variety ofweather conditions in Floridaand itstropical climate.[99]Like Florida, the state of Leonida inGrand Theft Auto VIcan receive seasonal hurricanes andtropical stormswith dynamic cloud formations allowing for localised rain showers in certain areas of the world.[100]During storms, visibility is reduced and winds become more prominent. After heavy rain spells, persistent puddles can form on the ground and rainwater can pour from rooftops or lamp posts.Rainbowscan also be observed under the correct lighting conditions.[101]

Grand Theft Auto VIfeatures various radio stations covering genres such aspop,country,hip-hop,African,Latin,classic rock,metal, and more. Radio stations like V-Rock, Flash FM, and Emotion 98.3 return fromGrand Theft Auto: Vice CityandGrand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories, along with 1980s throwback station Vice City FM fromGrand Theft Auto: Episodes from Liberty City.[102]The game includes "Kamikazi", a previously unreleased song by the American singer-songwriterD'Angelo, who died in 2025.[103]

Like previous entries in the series, Rockstar hired musicians to host some of the in-game radio stations inGrand Theft Auto VI, includingLana Del ReyandMorgan Wallen, who host the country station Back Country Radio, Puerto Rican singersBad BunnyandRaiNao, who host the Latin station Cocoteo FM,[104]Nigerian singerBurna Boy, who hosts the African station AfroBank FM, andRobynandAlex Consani, who host the pop station Flash FM. Miami-Dade County natives and rappersTrinaandTrick Daddyhost hip hop radio station Dirty South Classics.[105]"Weird Al" Yankovicvoices the DJ for Vice City FM.[106]ComedianStavros Halkiasportrays a host of the fictional right-wingtalk radiostation WKTT, which previously appeared inGrand Theft Auto IV.[107]Brazilian singerAnittahostsAsk Dr. Nita, a show on the talk station The Wipe in which she plays a doctor who answers questions about sex and relationships, with actressBarbie Ferreiravoicing a character named Bobby who appears on the show.[108][109]In a first for the series, players can listen to on-demandpodcastsoutside of a vehicle through their in-game smartphone.[110]

On 15 October, it was revealed that the French electronic duoJusticewould compose the original score.[111][112]Justice composed three hours of original music, and have collaborated with artists such asTame Impala,SZA,King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard,[113]Michael McDonald,the Weeknd, andDjoon original songs for the game.[1][2]Justice is credited with composing the main score, with contributions featuringBoys Noize,Gesaffelstein, King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard, andPhil Collen.[1][2]Overmonoare credited with composing the additional score; supplemental music is composed by100 Gecs,A. G. Cook, Bitter Babe,Bobby Krlic, Boys Noize,Cardo Got Wings, Daniel Tennenbaum, Danny Daze,DJ Python,Idles, Martyn Bootyspoon, Nick León,Oh No, Polygonia, SkipOnDaBeat, Sofie Birch, andTake a Daytrip.[1][2]

Rockstar announced that the first trailer was set to premiere in December 2023 for the company's 25th anniversary.[114][g]A low-quality version wasleakedone day early on 4 December; Rockstar published the official version in response, revealing the title, protagonists, setting, release window, and consoles.[118]The trailer broke someYouTuberecords within the first day,[h]and surpassed the lifetime viewership ofGrand Theft Auto V's 2011 reveal trailer within two days, with 101million views.[124]The trailer drew several fan-created recreations,[125]and its featured song,Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road", increased in popularity.[126][i]

A second trailer was released on 6 May 2025,[31]alongside a website update with 70 screenshots and several character and location descriptions.[34][127]The trailer, recorded on the PlayStation 5,[128]featuresthe Pointer Sisters's song "Hot Together",[j]Wang Chung's "Everybody Have Fun Tonight", "Child Support" byZenglen[fr;ht], andTammy Wynette's "Talkin' to Myself Again".[130]It received a record 475million views across all platforms within 24 hours,[129][k]and won Best Game Trailer at the Golden Joystick Awards in 2025.[133]

Rockstar unveiled the cover art andspecial editionson 18 June 2026.[134]TheUltimate Editiongrants additional in-game clothing, hairstyles, locations, missions, tattoos, vehicles, and weapons, while preorders receive theVintage Vice City Pack, featuring items inspired byGrand Theft Auto: Vice City(2002) and its protagonist,Tommy Vercetti.[135]Whilst this content would be locked behind theUltimate Edition, Rockstar confirmed toKinda Funnythat there would be nomicrotransactionsin either version of the game at launch. Rockstar also confirmed that there is nogenerative AI.[136]

On 24 June, Rockstar announced that physical versions, containing download codes in lieu of discs to prevent leaks andreselling, were set to be available in shops on 12 November, allowing pre-loading a week before the game unlocks.[137]Players and journalists criticised content locked behind special editions,[138]as well as the lack of discs because ofownership restrictions,[139]and some retailers refused to stock the game.[140]Preorders opened on 25 June; by August, Take-Two called sales "unprecedented and astonishing",[141][l]with most opting for theUltimate Edition.[144][m]In November 2026, just ahead of its release, Take-Two's CEOStrauss Zelnickstated that the company's presales expectations for the game had been exceeded significantly.[146]

Preorders initiated the marketing campaign,[147]for which Rockstar partnered with severalsocial media platformsand companies such asNetflixandPlayStation.[148][149]Dazedran aGrand Theft AutoVIcover story for its September issue, published online on 26 August.[18]An "extended look" at the game premiered onNetflixon 27 August, several hours before its YouTube release,[150]followed by previews fromcontent creators;[151]Netflix approached Rockstar with the idea, wanting to pursue popular cultural moments, and journalists noted the partnership signalled that the game is "a major entertainment tentpole".[149]Netflix andTwitchservers experienced technical issues upon the premiere, due to a substantial viewership demand and traffic.[17][152]On 3 September, two limited edition themedDualSensecontrollers in black and white were announced with a release alongside the game.[153]On 17 September, Rockstar announcedGrand Theft Auto VI: The Album, a soundtrack album featuring 34 original songs.[154]On 24 September, Rockstar announced theGrand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, a collection of accessories and merchandise, such as a map of Leonida and a crossbody bag; they note on the site that the video game is sold separately.[155][156][157]

Rockstar released a pre-launch trailer on 15 October. The song "Flower in a Hurricane" byJusticefeaturingTame Impala,SZA, andKing Gizzard & the Lizard Wizardwas used in the trailer.[111]Exclusive footage showcasing Jason using dog feces as a weapon to assault an NPC was featured in an episode ofSouth Parktitled "Guinea Pig on a Stick".[158]

AsGrand Theft Auto VI's Vice City setting is a fictionalised version of Miami, Rockstar wanted to use the real city as a marketing tool.Miami-Dade Countyapproached Rockstar with a pitch for the marketing campaign to take over various parts of Miami.[159]The marketing campaign was approved by the Miami-Dade County Commission in September, although some local Miami elected officials objected to the campaign such as suggesting the game promotes a culture of violence.[160]County CommissionerRené Garcíaexpressed feeling "really uncomfortable" with the city collaborating with a "game that's depicting Miami like a crime haven" or could be glorifying the city's history of crime.[161]

Starting from 1 October, the roof of theKaseya Centerwas lit up with signage reading "Welcome to Vice City" that cost $975,000.[162][163]In mid-October, wrapped cars based on the fictional vehicles of theGrand Theft Autoseries with Leonida number plates were spotted on Miami streets, a Vice Cityblimpwas seen in the skies, and Vice City-branded beach chairs and umbrellas were distributed onMiami Beach.[164]Rockstar would later recreate real footage of the wrapped cars inside the video game and release it as "real footage" via a Miami-Dade County-branded social media account as a marketing tactic.[165]On 6 November, Miami nightclubE11evenwas rebranded into the in-game equivalent club Nine1Nine.[166][167]The opening night event featured a performance from rapperFlo Rida.[168][169][170]

On 9 November, Rockstar Games announced a live music festival atMana Wynwoodin Miami starting on 21 November and ending on 22 November,[171][172]featuring several musicians who appear onGrand Theft Auto VI: The Album, including Travis Scott,Cardi B,Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Justice,Metro Boomin,Don Toliver,Kodak Black,Fcukers, andRauw Alejandro.[173]Rockstar also collaborated withNBAbasketball teamMiami HeatforA Night in Vice City, a one-night event during the concurrent2026–27 NBA seasonwhere the Heat played as "Vice City" against theMilwaukee Buckson 18 November, a day before the game's release.[174][175][176]Additionally, marketing extended over the team's uniform, stadium, and court, among others.[177][178]Miami's jerseys and game day merchandise were designed in collaboration withNikeandTravis Scott'sCactus Jack Records.[179]A special "Vice City" edition ofNBA 2K27will be released on 27 November, as part of the game's 3rd season, featuring Miami Heat playerBam Adebayoon the cover.[180]

Details aboutGrand Theft Auto VIemerged from insider reports several years before its announcement,[n]and the lack of official acknowledgement received media attention.[183]Rockstar confirmed development was "well underway" on 4 February 2022.[184]The game became highly anticipated,[185][o]for which it won awards atthe Game AwardsandGolden Joystick Awardsin both 2024 and 2025;[187][133]scammers used the anticipation to promotemalwareandfraudthrough false promises ofearly access.[188]A meme indicated bemusement that surprising events occurred "beforeGTA 6".[189]A trend of workers and employees requestingpaid time offorcalling in sickon the day of release also surfaced; aPCMagsurvey found that millions of American adults intended to take a day off to play the game.[190]A method was used by players to alter their console's region toNew Zealandto play the game ahead of time, in which the method was dubbed the "New Zealand Trick". In anInstagramreel posted byTourism New Zealand, a caption had bantered that "one perk of seeing the sun first" was "gettingGTA 6first too", inviting players to use such trick.[191][192][193]

Some publishers rescheduled games to avoid competition;[194]Jason SchreierofBloomberg Newscalled it "a massive game of4D chessplaying out across the entire video game industry".[195]Industry figures hoped the game would set new pricing trends,[p]and analysts predicted record-breaking revenue.[q]The game was nearly banned in South Korea, as members of theGame Rating and Administration Committeeargued that the current "bodily exposure of sexual acts" found in the game "are depicted explicitly or excessively so as to disrupt social order". The board reportedly felt pressure to approve the game as they did not want to be "the sole country to refuse classification to the biggest game of the year".[202][203][204]

The firsttrailerin December 2023 revealed a 2025 release window.[118]Following March 2024 reports that the game was at risk of delay,[205]Rockstar's parent companyTake-Two Interactivesaid it remained on schedule for late 2025.[206]Employees were doubtful due to the amount of remaining work,[207]and in May 2025, the game was delayed to 26 May 2026.[208]In November 2025, Rockstar delayed the game to 19 November 2026 for further polishing.[209]Journalists noted the firings did not cause the delay but could impact deadlines;[210]a Rockstar North employee said morale was "at rock bottom".[211]In October 2026, industry sources reported that a PC release is expected in the first quarter of 2027.[212][213]

On 10 November, Xbox announced that the game would be playable on theXbox Oneconsole throughXbox Cloud Gaming.[214]The game was released forPlayStation 5andXbox Series X and Series Ssystems on 19 November, with noWindowsrelease scheduledas of November2026[update].[215]A former Rockstar producer said the studio typically develops for consoles first rather thanpersonal computersbecause "it's always better to start with the constraints and then extend".[216]In August 2026, Rockstar confirmed the game would run at 30frames per second(FPS) on both consoles at launch.[217][218]By October 2026, the game had reported to have contributed to a 22% increase in PlayStation 5 console sales.[219]Comcast, aninternet service providerin the US, reported that 19 November was their highest traffic day in the company's history, reaching 31% over an average day's traffic load, partly due to people downloading the game, which made up about a quarter of the traffic.[220]

A user, identified as "teapotuberhacker",[r]published 90 videos to the websiteGTAForumson 18 September 2022, showing 50 minutes of work-in-progress game footage.[222]The hacker downloaded the files from Rockstar's internalSlackgroups,[223]and also threatened to publishsource code, assets, andinternal buildsofGrand Theft AutoVandVI.[224]Take-Two submittedtakedownsof YouTube videos andforumthreads showing the footage.[225]Journalists described the event as one of the biggest leaks invideo game history,[226]called "a nightmare for Rockstar" by Schreier,[227]and "aPRdisaster" byJefferies Groupanalyst Andrew Uerkwitz.[228][229]Several developers offered sympathies,[222][230]and they also shared work-in-progress footage of their games in solidarity.[231]Rockstar lamented the manner in which the game was first demonstrated.[232]Rockstar said in court that the incident cost the company $5million and thousands of staff hours to recover,[233]and prompted increasedcybersecuritymeasures.[234]

A 17-year-old boy fromOxfordshire, identified as "teapotuberhacker" and a key member of the groupLapsus$,[235]was arrested by theCity of London Policeon 22September as part of an investigation supported by theNational Cyber Crime Unitand American federal law enforcement.[236][s]While onbailfor hackingEEandNvidiaand underpolice protectionat aTravelodgehotel, he breached Rockstar using a mobile phone, television, andFire TV Stick, and threatened to release the source code in aSlackmessage to all Rockstar staff.[235][238]Appearing before ayouth court, hepleadedguilty to breaching bail conditions and not guilty tocomputer misuse.[239][240]

In mid-2023, he stood trial atSouthwark Crown Courtfor twelve offences, including six counts of computer misuse, three ofblackmail, and two of fraud.[235][241]He was deemedunfit to stand trialdue to hisautism;[238]a jury determined he had committed the acts,[235][242]and a judge placed him under an indefinitehospital orderin December for being a high public risk as he was violent in custody and expressed intent to continue committingcybercrimes.[233][238]He was moved to aprisonin July 2026,[243]and pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar and other companies in November.[244]The following week he was sentenced to 7 years in prison, and was subsequently releasedon licencefor time served with a warning from the judge.[245]

In January 2025, aReddituser known as "JustLovett0" posted a photograph and two videos of a PlayStation 5development kitrunning the game, taken atRockstar San Diegoin mid-2021.[246]After the post was deleted,Polygon's Ian Walker wrote that it revealed no new information and called it the "worst leak of all time".[247]In November, some development footage appeared in former Rockstar animator Benjamin Chue'sshowreel.[248]

The in-game map and several minutes of footage were leaked in August 2026 by an account known as "CyberLeek", who threatened to release more material unless plans were changed regarding special edition–only content and lack of discs.[249]Journalists compared the demands to theStop Killing Gamesmovement,[t]although some expressed concern that it was acryptocurrency scamowing to a watermark on released video promoting their "$CYBERLEEK"meme coin.[251]CyberLeekburnedcoins valued at more thanUS$1millionin response,[252]claiming to raise money for a "secret project" to fight anti-consumer publishing practices.[253]

Some footage suggested CyberLeek had a playable build of the game,[254]with voting via paid tokens determining which clips leaked next;[255]at least 16 videos were leaked over nine daysby 26August[update].[256]Some leaked footage raised concerns about a possible graphical downgrade from the first trailer.[257]Take-Two filedsubpoenarequests withDiscord,Microsoft, andX Corp.in theUS District Court for the Southern District of New York, seeking records to identify CyberLeek.[255][258]PopularGrand Theft Autostreamer DarkViperAU's Discord server was among the few that were subpoenaed.[258]

Rockstar publicly acknowledged the leaks on 26 August, calling them "heartbreaking for our team", and apologised for the delays in development and marketing.[259]On 27 August, media reported that CyberLeek had withdrawn roughly $268,000 in transaction fees to four different crypto wallets hours ahead ofGrand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Lookon Netflix, leading to a collapse in the value of the meme coin and speculation that the leaks had ended.[260]In October, CyberLeek released further material, including gameplay videos depicting Jason and Lucia exploring the open world while nude.[u]Nicole Carpenter ofAftermathnoted the NPCs' lack of reaction to Jason's nudity in one of the videos, and surmised that CyberLeek was likely using adebug modeto create the videos rather than taking advantage of an intended feature.[263]

On 19 November, the day of the game's release, CyberLeek uploaded an Xbox build of the game viaBitTorrentwithout the main executable.[266]On 23 November, the main executable was released upon hitting a crypto milestone set earlier.[267]The release seemed to show that CyberLeek's access was not limited to early development builds. It was predicted that with the executable released, an unofficial PC port could be made in a matter of days.[268]

According to the review aggregatorMetacritic,Grand Theft Auto VIreceived "universal acclaim" on critic reviews, with a score of 99 out of 100,[269][270]becoming the site's best reviewed game among critics alongsideThe Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time(1998).[288][x]As of 2026[update], it is the only game of the 21st century to receive a 99 score on the site.OpenCriticassessed that 100% of critics recommend it.[271]Critics praised the game's large variety of content, open world, characters, and expanding on elements from prior instalments in the series.[291][293][294]Many referred to the game as a masterpiece.[295][296]

In a review by Sam White forGQ, the state of Leonida is described as the "most technically and artistically impressive game world ever made".[297]The game receivedThe New York Times's"Critics Pick" designation, with Yussef Cole heavily praising Lucia and Jason's relationship as the main highlight, writing that the true achievement is "the well-earned satisfaction of an authentic human bond".[298]Writing inThe New Yorker, Julian Lucas praised the open world's "kinetic density" and reactive NPCs, arguing that "the culture-war frame is a distraction" from the game's visceral depiction of social and economic insecurity.[299]

In a 5/5 review forThe Guardian, Keza MacDonald praised the narrative's tonal shift to a more grounded, emotional stance, and commended how the female characters are given more depth compared to previous entries in the series.[286]Alberto Lloret fromHobbyConsolasqualified the game as "a colossal adventure in a vast world, overflowing with detail and so much content that you can finish the story without seeing much of it", and reviewed it with a 100/100 score, the first in the magazine's 35-year history.[300]Igromania'sreview gave the game 10/10, noting "optional immersive mechanics, chemistry between Jason and Lucia, random events, an abundance of content" and "exceptional attention to detail".[301]

Criticism has been directed at theframe ratecap of 30 frames per second, potentially awkward aiming controls, and a handful of missing features established in previous releases.[302]In her review forScreenHub, Alice Clark stated that "there are large sections where it is an absolutely epic game, and large sections that are boring and too limited".[303]Meanwhile, Isabelle Maurel fromJeuxvideo.comrated the game 19/20, mentioning there were occasional frame-rate drops and formulaic gang hideouts.[304]

The user score on Metacritic was drastically lower than the critic score following release,[305][306]stabilising at around 5.7/10 by 24 November,[307]which was a result ofreview bombing.[308][309][310]Among those reviews include ones that are politically charged or admit they "haven't even played the game" themselves.[310]Also affectingGrand Theft Auto VI'suser score were fans of the2026 remake ofOcarina of Time, who created new accounts to giveOcarina of Timea perfect score andGrand Theft Auto VIa zero, in an attempt to ensure thatOcarina of Timeretained the user score record on Metacritic.[306][311][312]

The day after release,Grand Theft Auto VIsaw a Metacritic user score as low as 3.7/10,[313]before it rose to 5.0/10.[310]Conversely, on thePlayStation StoreandMicrosoft Store—where reviews are restricted to verified purchasers—Grand Theft Auto VIrespectively maintained a rating of 4.84 out of 5 from approximately 170,000 user submissions and 4.9 out of 5 by 21 November.[305][306]SomeGrand Theft Auto VIfans responded by review bombing bothOcarina of Time(the original and remake),Super Mario Galaxy 2andSoulcalibur(the third and fourth highest rated game on Metacritic).[314][315]

Several industry creatives voiced awe at the technological achievements ofGrand Theft Auto VI. Creative director Igor Sarzyński ofCD Projekt Redremarked the game is "probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history" in terms of scale, density, and coherence.[316][317]Naughty Dog's Michael Barclay, whose credits includeUncharted: The Lost LegacyandThe Last of Us Part II, likened his reaction to how "aBugatti Veyronwould appear to a nervousVictorianchild".[318]

Several law enforcement agencies around the world issued reminders to gamers about the "critical boundary" between the digital entertainment and real life, including police agencies from the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and the Philippines.[319]The warning from thePhilippine National Policecoincided with the aftermath of incidents in 2026 involving students and firearms in the country, including three school attacks inTacloban City,Zamboanga City, andSouth Cotabato.[320]

Grand Theft Auto VIsold 32.5million copies before its release, becoming the 30thbest-selling game of all timesolely on preorder sales.[326][327]The digital analytics platformSensor Towerestimated that it had sold 24.58million preorder copies fromdigital storefronts, equating to an approximate revenue of US$2.36billion.[328][329]This made it the most preordered video game of all time, surpassing the previous record of 8million copies held byCyberpunk 2077.[329][330][331]Approximately 75% of preorders were made forPlayStation 5, while the remaining 25% were forXbox Series X/S.[328][329]

The game generated US$3.79billion within 24 hours of its release, making it the largest entertainment product launch in history,[326][332]exceeding the box office of thehighest-grossing film,Avengers: Endgame, by nearly $1 billion.[333]It broke the previous launch-day entertainment sales record set by its predecessorGrand Theft Auto V, which generated US$815.7million in 2013.[334][335]As of 22 November, Sony revealed that over 39 million people playedGrand Theft Auto VI, making it the best launch inPlayStationhistory.[336][337]
